title: The Invisible Forest
author: Elliot Sperber
content:
![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/IMG_9964.jpeg)

White oak, Turkey Run State Park, Indiana. Photo: Jeffrey St. Clair.

The invisible forest is made up  
Of trees (of beeches/books  
Made up of leaves  
Turning  
Invisibly, this forest  
Through which we walk  
Determining our path,  
The tree trunks - the caudex -  
The codes  
Determine the widths  
Of the streets, the roads  
The materials that constitute  
The sidewalks  
Of our constitutionals  
The composition of the air  
We struggle to breathe  
Because of these
